messages:
Maya Patel: Quick check on a few microcopy/a11y items from the eval UI pass. Starting with the row 26hellip; button. We changed the visible tooltip to 'More actions' but screen readers only say 'button'. Can we improve?
Samir Khan: Yep — I inspected the markup: <button class="row-ellipsis">…</button> no aria-label/title.
Rachel Li: If there's no aria-label it'll fall back to role only. We should give it context like aria-label="More actions for {rowName}".
Evan Torres: Or "Row actions: {rowName}" to keep the verb out of the label. Shorter reads better in VO.
Maya Patel: I want consistency with the visual tooltip which reads 'More actions'. Let's do aria-label="More actions for {rowName}" and add a title attribute for hover/focus.
Samir Khan: Implementation note: avoid duplicating the label if we're using aria-labelledby to reference the row title. Simpler to set aria-label directly when rowName is available.
Rachel Li: Also if the rowName is long, truncate for SRs: e.g., "More actions for model 'Searcher'" instead of spitting the entire resource name.
Maya Patel: Good. Next: Eval page empty state. Current CTA is just 'Create' which is ambiguous. Suggestions?
Evan Torres: I like 'Add prompt set' as CTA, header could be 'Add your first prompt set'.
Samir Khan: +1. Subtext: 'Use prompt sets to snapshot inputs, measure regressions, and track metrics.'
Rachel Li: Tone should be action-oriented and descriptive. CTA = 'Add prompt set', helper = 'Use prompt sets to track latency & quality across changes.'
Maya Patel: Toast copy we currently show: 'Request failed, try again later.' Too generic. Some failures are rate-limits. Proposals?
Samir Khan: Toast: 'Save failed 14 try again' (short) with an action button 'Contact support'. Expanded error panel can mention rate-limiting and link to docs.
Rachel Li: In the panel: 'Save failed 14 you may be rate limited. Retry in a few seconds or see rate limit guidance.' Link to /docs/rate-limits.
Evan Torres: For transient retry flows, maybe include a small retry throttle so users don't hammer the API. But that's infra. Copy-wise I like compact toast + actionable button.
Maya Patel: Final one: delete model variant dialog. Current title = 'Delete?'. That's too vague. We should be explicit: title = 'Delete model variant' body = 'This will remove variant "v2-quant" from serving. Any routes targeting it will fall back to the default model.' Primary button = 'Delete variant' secondary = 'Cancel'.
Samir Khan: Explicit primary button text helps keyboard users and auditability. Also include the variant name in the dialog DOM and aria-live region for status update.
DesignBot: Checklist update: "All row ellipsis controls must have aria-labels that include resource names (truncated if needed), tooltips must be keyboard focusable, toasts should be concise + include an action when helpful, confirmation dialogs must use explicit primary action labels."
Maya Patel: Samir — can you bundle these into one small PR (JS + copy + a11y attrs) and include before/after SR screenshots?
Samir Khan: Yep. I'll add examples & test notes in the PR description. Target: EOD.
Rachel Li: I'll review and run the a11y smoke tests.
Evan Torres: I can test confirm dialog keyboard/voiceover flows once it's up.
Maya Patel: Thanks everyone :sparkles:
